code:
-- Capture full plan with timing, buffers, and verbose output
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, VERBOSE, SETTINGS, FORMAT TEXT)
SELECT *
FROM {{table_name}}
WHERE {{where_column}} = $1;

-- Reading the plan top-down:
--   Seq Scan       => no index used, full table read
--   Index Scan     => index hit, but still fetches heap
--   Index Only Scan=> best case, no heap fetch (needs VACUUM fresh)
--   Bitmap Heap+Index Scan => many matching rows, range scan style
--   Rows Removed by Filter: N => index not selective enough
--   Buffers: shared hit=A read=B => B = cache miss, the real cost
--   actual time=X..Y rows=R loops=L => total = (Y-X) * L ms
-- Estimate vs actual rows off by >10x => run ANALYZE {{table_name}}
summary_zh: EXPLAIN ANALYZE 各節點解讀指南，標出 seq scan、buffers、estimate 偏差等訊號
